title: Released government reports of UFOs over Savannah River, Oak Ridge and Los Alamos
place_text: Savannah River facility; Oak Ridge National Laboratory; Los Alamos

tellings.quote: when you look in there you see actual verbatim UFO incidents back in the 50s and 60s over the pH Savannah River facility y over what Oakridge National Laboratory over what Los Alamos

plain: Among roughly 10,000 UFO-related reports the government has released, there are said to be word-for-word accounts of UFO incidents in the 1950s and 60s over the Savannah River nuclear facility, Oak Ridge National Laboratory and Los Alamos. Luis Elizondo, a guest who discusses the government's UFO files, tells Michels this from the released records without naming a specific one; the point is that the objects showed interest in America's most sensitive nuclear sites.
